newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Atlas says rehabilitation plan approved.
newsitem.headline: Atlas says rehabilitation plan approved.

text.p: Atlas Consolidated Mining and Development Corp said on Thursday that a new group of investors had approved rehabilitation plans for its Cebu copper mines.
The new group of investors was led by businessmen Frank Lubbock and Martin Buckingham who were elected to the board during a special board meeting earlier in the day.
"The rehabilitation plan and the mining plan have already been agreed to by ACMDC and the investors," the company said in a statement.
Details of the rehabilitation plan were not disclosed.
The new investors have already advanced the cash needed for the monthly site maintenance and the amount used to partly pay for the separation benefits of former employees, it said.
